takeaway: The normal gastro-oesophageal junction is 40 cm from the incisors.

lines.text: A fifty-year-old man has heartburn and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease.
He is due to have an oesophagogastroduodenoscopy, a camera passed through the mouth.
lines.say: He is due to have an oesophago-gastro-duodenoscopy, a camera passed through the mouth.

lines.text: During the scope, distances are measured from the incisors, the front teeth.
The normal gastro-oesophageal junction is found forty centimetres from the incisors.
So remember the number: forty centimetres from the incisors to the normal gastro-oesophageal junction.
